primary_question: Do exact shared-budget intervals and their difference from matched singleton/additive approximations replicate on independently sourced biological tissue?
donor_claim: Two source tumor donors per vendor page, independent of lung. Independence from the existing breast format-test donor is unknown and will not be claimed.

selection.centers: For each source, form target points at the 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles of cell-centroid x and the median y. Choose the nearest cell centroid to each target, tie by source row order. Snap origin down to the 0.2125-um grid. Keep all three regions regardless of counts/outcomes; report any overlaps or source-edge truncation.
selection.source_owner: Native masks/1 with native masks/0 nuclear constraints; original transform, coordinates and IDs retained. Vendor transcript owners retained separately and discrepancies counted.
selection.quality: All measured-gene transcripts with qv>=20; no outcome-based gene selection.

atlas: Unmodified primary extractor: widths [4,2,1,0.5] pixels, displacement band 3/4, slope 1, fixed seams/nuclei; geometric validity and witnesses checked.
comparisons: Euclidean distance-counting outer interval at the primary global displacement cap, explicitly looser in geometry and area budget
reporting: all queries and outer-width>=2 eligible queries separately
invariance explicitly conditional on atlas coverage/displacement
all failures and incomplete spectra excluded from exact claims, retained in status

proseg.regions: Same 200-um cores, run on 200-um and 800-um windows. Evaluate identical retained transcript IDs in core and fixed source-cell identity mapping.
proseg.settings: Default Xenium preset, 2 threads, burnin200/samples200/hillclimb50. No-factorization is a separately labelled matched sensitivity analysis, never silently substituted.
metrics: per-cell count inclusion and full assignment representability are distinct metrics
proseg.interpretation: Alternative segmentation comparisons; no ground-truth accuracy claim.

manual_reference.eligibility: Require documented annotation semantics, same-slide image/transcript coordinate registration, and whole-cell reference boundaries. Nuclear-only masks or uncertain registration will not be labelled whole-cell truth.
manual_reference.analysis: If eligible, freeze selected regions and reference matching before reading GeoCert outcomes; measure reference correction representability, count containment and widths with out-of-family references included.
manual_reference.fallback: Report a specific blocker if annotations are unavailable, require access approval, or cannot support whole-cell reference assignment.

scope: No new moving-junction geometry or claim of biological calibration from simulation. Registered abstract unchanged.

amendments.reason: Downloaded archive contains native cell and nucleus raster masks. Use them directly rather than rasterizing polygon approximations. Regions remain selected from cell centroids, independently of expression.
amendments.replacement: Reference owners from native masks/1, nuclei masks/0; isotropic source transform preserved exactly. Vendor transcript owners retained; differences counted.
